tests: Choosing managed container orchestration with no EC2 hosts to manage and billing per container resources.
expected: Amazon ECS or EKS on AWS Fargate — no servers, billed per task vCPU and memory. Triggers: "containerized", "no management of underlying EC2", "billing per container resources".
why_not: ECS EC2 launch type and Docker on EC2 require managing servers; single-instance Elastic Beanstalk runs on an EC2 instance with no per-task billing.
